title: The dream of the city
caption: I dreamt of a city that was on no map.

captions.text: Towers at the very water’s edge, and a light in every window.
And over them shining fish swam slowly.
I did not know where it was. I knew only that I must go there.

craft.means: Petra’s strength: how many shining fish over the city (up to three) and how big

dream.means: the dream is clear (less — mist over the water, the city paler)

lights.means: the city’s lights: windows, light on the water

waking.means: waking: the towers sink in sparks, it grows dark, the bedroom window with its frame shows through

lead.means: “Hold the dream”: where the leading fish is on its way over the city, 0…1 (the game leads it over 40 s); null — it drifts by itself

gaze.means: “Hold the dream”: where along the fish’s way David looks, −1…1 (the place (gaze + 1) / 2 of the same way): his head and a light spot on the sky; null — at the city

objects.name: Ears of grain at the edge
